# Doral Tinting (concept site by Kerblabs)

> Window tint, vinyl wraps and paint protection film shop at 4300 NW 72 Ave, Miami, FL 33166. Phone 305-763-7759. Site: https://www.doraltinting.com

## Services
- Window tint: nano-carbon, ceramic, hyper ceramic
- Vinyl car wraps, boat wraps, custom decals, graphic design
- Paint protection film (PPF)
- Car audio, starlights/LED lighting, rock lights
- Wheel powder coating
- Mobile service for residential and commercial work (per their site)

## Listed promotions (confirm with shop)
- Nano-carbon tint $120, ceramic tint $199, hyper ceramic tint $299, full front PPF $1,699

## FAQ
- How do I book? Call 305-763-7759 or use the Get a Quote form on doraltinting.com.
